recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿骨髓單核芽細胞，核呈摺疊或腎形、細胞質灰藍帶空泡與細顆粒，右上角可見一顆顆粒散出的嗜酸性系細胞；急性骨髓單核球性白血病型態加上嗜酸球異常時要想到 inv(16)。
features: Hypercellular smear dominated by medium to large blasts and promonocyte-like cells
Nuclei round to folded, indented or kidney-shaped with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles
Mixed myeloid and monocytic differentiation (myelomonocytic picture)
Occasional granulated eosinophil-lineage cell with dispersed granules (upper right); granule color not well resolved at this power
Scattered small lymphocytes and a nucleated red cell
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population of medium-to-large blasts and promonocyte-like cells with round to folded or kidney-shaped nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine granules and vacuoles. The findings indicate both granulocytic and monocytic differentiation. An eosinophil-lineage cell with dispersed granules is present, although abnormal basophilic eosinophil granules cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia, compatible with AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/CBFB::MYH11 in the appropriate cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: M3v cells have bilobed butterfly nuclei and are HLA-DR/CD34 negative with PML::RARA, whereas this marrow shows monocytic vacuolated cells and eosinophil lineage involvement.
Pure monocytic leukemia lacks the granulocytic component and abnormal eosinophils; cytogenetics separates KMT2A rearrangement from inv(16).
CMML has <20% blasts plus promonocytes with a more mature monocytic and dysplastic granulocytic background.
